items.title:
1/🚨 A “measles-positive” PCR does NOT tell you everything you think it does.

It can detect measles RNA.

But by itself, it CANNOT tell you:

• wild vs vaccine strain
• viable vs residual virus
• who infected whom
• whether measles caused a death

That is the Measles Certainty Gap — and why official outbreak counts often rest on surveillance classifications that do not establish strain, infectiousness, transmission source, or causation in every individual case. 🧵👇
